title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.coprime_self_add_left
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.coprime_self_add_left` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, (m + n).Coprime m ↔ n.Coprime m
formal.kernel_statement: theorem Nat.coprime_self_add_left : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Iff (Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.gcd (AxNat.add x0 x1) x0) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) (Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.gcd x1 x0) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))))

evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- coprime_self_add_left 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.coprime_self_add_left[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate, which re-checks the constructed proof term against the stated type: `coprime_add_self_left` instantiated at `(n, m)` gives `Iff (gcd (n+m) m = 1) (gcd n m = 1)`; `add_comm` congr'd through `gcd _ m` transports its left side from `gcd (n+m) m` to `gcd (m+n) m`, the same congruence-transport shape `coprime_self_add_right` uses over `coprime_add_self_right`. `nat_theorem_inventory` exits non-zero for a name that does not exist, and the `grep -c` requires the admitted declaration to be printed.

A theorem cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain, so an empty trusted surface bounds every individual theorem's footprint by [].
